source.title: Cracking the Cyber-Puzzle: KDMF in Action

award_evidence.locator: ICM Outstanding Winners, Problem F, Team 2513705
award_evidence.verification: Official COMAP award and institution matched; year/problem/team visually checked on the PDF summary sheet.

claim: Descriptive country profiles, policy-text/DID analysis and demographic associations form three complementary evidence streams for cybersecurity policy advice.

manuscript_evidence.supports: Four country indicators are introduced; K-means clustering specifically uses NCSI and Legal Measures, with elbow/silhouette and PCA analysis.
LDA describes six policy topics; before/after treated/control differences are analyzed with covariates.
MIC, factor analysis and regression characterize demographic and socioeconomic associations.
DID-coefficient perturbation and MIC input-noise sensitivity.
Advice integrates the streams; reporting bias and imperfect controls limit interpretation.

model_relationships.meaning: Descriptive clustering input; other indicators are not added to the clustering pair

references.borrowed: Unnumbered Our Work illustration on physical PDFp4 was visually inspected. Retain the three task groups but lay them out in parallel with an explicit advice merge.
references.not_borrowed: Source pixels, layout coordinates, paper-specific numerical results, team/award labels and unsupported causal claims.

caption: Method overview of KDMF. Country indicators support descriptive clustering; policy texts and demographic covariates support topic-based difference-in-differences analysis; demographic data support MIC and regression-based associations. The three evidence streams converge on policy advice, with perturbation and noise checks shown separately. Cluster marks and comparison cells are schematic; no estimated effect or statistical result is reproduced.
placement: End of Introduction / Our Work, before assumptions. Intended 180mm full-text width; physical print proof pending.

review.review_type: informed visual self-review; not independent acceptance
review.execution_test: completed: full paper read, reference viewed, actual image generated, inspected and corrected where needed
checks: Clustering input explicitly NCSI + legal measures; three clusters labelled schematic.
All six source policy themes are present.
DID matrix has treated/control rows and before/after columns.
Corrected covariate arrow now enters the DID method, not the final association result.
MIC and regression remain association methods; no claimed causal effect or efficacy ranking.
Three streams converge on policy brief; white background and title contrast corrected.
Final saved image inspected for labels and connector endpoints.

issues.detail: 180mm physical-size/grayscale proof and independent review not performed. Small connector labels require checking in the manuscript layout.

source_notes: The source's policy-effect sign interpretations and some coefficient descriptions are internally inconsistent. The overview omits numeric effects, rankings and claims of validated effectiveness.
Shared indicators are shown at the policy-analysis grouping level; the figure does not specify a new regression.
